| getBit | Returns the value of the bit at selected position for a unsigned input value |

| --- | --- | --- |
| bitPosition | Position of the bit that needs to be fetched. | uint8 OneToOne |
| bitLeiste | Input value | u16:uint16 u32:uint32  u8:uint8  OneToOne |
| return | The value of selected bit. | uint8 |
